reviews.title: On Target
reviews.text: The app is well designed. It is easy to use and easy to understand. Calculations help so much.

reviews.title: Not inclusive
reviews.text:
I didn’t even get to start using it. I was putting in my height and weight. My weight wasn’t even listed. I’d say a lot of users who would be tracking calories are probably trying to lose weight. You’d think it would be catered to people who track for fitness & weight loss. 
Current weight is 284
Max weight I would select is 279.

reviews.title: don’t get this app
reviews.text:
I put in all of my information, all of it made sense. 
tell me why it told me i could only eat 18 CALORIES A DAY? 
And I set up a free trial..
yeah, no thanks!

reviews.title: Deceiving
reviews.text: When I first entered the app, I thought I would actually be a good one. It looked nice and seemed like it cared about what i needed through the survey. Then the free trial popped up. I am not paying 7 to 29 dollars for a lousy app about calorie tracking. Just put the free trial up first to not waste my time.
